input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for base sender manager, sender manager, strategy sender manager. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Admin, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to use strategy sender manager capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a Admin, I want to use base sender connection manager capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
